research.notes: The Charity Navigator page blocked automated fetching, so the EIN and address (taken from its search-result text) may be dropped at verification. profile.summary: Project Shema is a nonprofit training and support organization. It works to address antisemitism, including anti-Jewish ideas that can come up in conversations about Israel and Palestine. It offers programs and workshops for college campuses, mission-driven organizations and K-12 schools.

review.notes: Charity Navigator blocked direct fetching, but its indexed text at the cited URL shows PROJECT SHEMA as a 501(c)(3) with EIN 93-2918074 at 1042 Maple Ave, Lisle, IL. That matches the agenda's Lisle, IL, and the organization's own site, projectshema.org, describes antisemitism training for campuses, mission-driven organizations and K-12 schools, which fits a General Counsel services agreement.
